database: Isolated MariaDB 10.11.14 (MySQL-compatible), no original/source database writes

results.name: versioned migrations run and rerun safely
non-default PORT and explicit 0.0.0.0 binding
all 12 public routes, canonical URLs and JSON-LD
static assets, sitemap and preview robots
genuine enquiries succeed only with durable, parameterized MySQL storage
idempotent retries and concurrent duplicate UUIDs
five-per-hour limit is enforced for simultaneous submissions
validation, cross-site rejection, content type, body bytes, HTTP methods and honeypot
public pages stay available without database config; genuine submissions fail clearly
database outage returns 503 without false success or exposed internals
Drizzle MySQL adapter reads and writes using the shared lazy pool
D1 converter preserves Unicode, IDs and timestamps; repeat import is idempotent; conflicts fail
desktop all routes have visible headings, resolved images and no horizontal overflow
package link preselects the enquiry service during Next.js navigation
desktop enquiry form submits successfully and shows its reference
mobile all routes fit the viewport; navigation works
mobile select, keyboard access and FAQ disclosure
no browser page errors
phpMyAdmin schema SQL is executable, repeatable and checksum-protected
npm start defaults to port 3000 and binds 0.0.0.0
clean production-indexable build has correct robots, metadata and host-specific preview noindex
